queries.query: ('large language model' OR LLM OR 'foundation model') AND ('network configuration' OR 'network configuration generation' OR 'intent-to-configuration' OR 'NetOps' OR 'network operations')
queries.rationale: Discover primary literature on using LLMs to generate, translate, or synthesize network configurations or NetOps artifacts (phenomenon and scope).

queries.query: ('network configuration' OR 'router configuration' OR 'ACL' OR 'BGP' OR 'OSPF') AND (verification OR validation OR 'formal verification' OR 'model checking' OR 'header space analysis' OR Batfish OR Veriflow)
queries.rationale: Collect established network-verification techniques and tools that can act as validators or oracles for LLM outputs (mechanisms for checking correctness).

queries.query: ('generate-validate-repair' OR 'generate and validate' OR 'generate-then-verify' OR 'LLM self-correction' OR 'tool-assisted self-correction' OR 'bounded self-correction') AND (network OR NetOps OR 'network configuration')
queries.rationale: Find architectures combining LLM generation with validation and iterative repair loops; directly relevant mitigations and workflows.

queries.query: ('hallucination' OR 'factual error' OR 'misconfiguration' OR 'generation error' OR 'incorrect output') AND ('large language model' OR LLM OR 'foundation model') AND (network OR 'configuration')
queries.rationale: Identify documented LLM failure modes (hallucinations, omissions, overconfidence) in operational or domain-specific generation tasks to understand mechanisms causing NetOps errors.
source_preferences: technical blog posts from research organizations (limited, verified)

queries.query: ('adversarial' OR 'robustness' OR 'attack' OR 'prompt injection' OR 'data poisoning') AND ('large language model' OR LLM OR agent) AND (network OR 'configuration' OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Survey adversarial and security threat models against LLMs and agentic systems that could cause erroneous or malicious NetOps outputs (mechanisms + threat mitigations).

queries.query: ('agentic' OR 'autonomous agent' OR 'AutoGPT' OR 'agent-based' OR 'tool-augmented agent') AND (NetOps OR 'network operations' OR 'AIOps' OR network)
queries.rationale: Locate work on agentic/autonomous frameworks applied (or applicable) to NetOps to understand orchestration, planning, and multi-step action risks.

queries.rationale: Find existing benchmarks and datasets relevant to NetOps/LLM evaluation and evaluate their coverage and limitations (benchmark validity).

queries.query: ('evaluation metric' OR 'metrics' OR 'functional correctness' OR 'exact match' OR 'semantic equivalence' OR 'operational correctness' OR 'test oracle') AND (configuration OR NetOps OR 'network configuration')
queries.rationale: Identify evaluation metrics and oracles that map model outputs to operational correctness rather than surface similarity (critical for benchmark validity and methods).

queries.query: ('Mininet' OR 'ns-3' OR 'emulation' OR 'simulation' OR 'testbed' OR 'network emulator') AND ('network configuration' OR 'NetOps' OR 'validation')
queries.rationale: Find realistic simulation and emulation environments to execute or validate generated configurations and measure operational effects (methods / evaluation environments).

queries.query: ('Batfish' OR 'Header Space Analysis' OR 'NetKAT' OR 'ProbNetKAT' OR 'Anteater' OR 'Veriflow') AND (paper OR 'system' OR 'tool' OR documentation)
queries.rationale: Collect primary references and practical docs for network-verification tools that can be used as validators or validators' baselines in experiments (methods & mitigations).

queries.query: ('human-in-the-loop' OR 'operator oversight' OR 'human oversight' OR 'human+AI collaboration') AND (NetOps OR 'network operations' OR 'AIOps' OR 'LLM' OR 'agent')
queries.rationale: Survey human oversight and decision-support strategies that reduce operational risk and their empirical effectiveness (mitigations and deployment practices).
source_preferences: case studies from industry (whitepapers with methods)

queries.query: ('program synthesis' OR 'code generation' OR 'LLM for code' OR Codex OR 'code LLM') AND ('configuration' OR 'infrastructure as code' OR 'IaC' OR 'network config')
queries.rationale: Explore adjacent literatures (code/IA C synthesis, program repair, verification) for transferable methods and validators applicable to NetOps tasks (neighbouring work).

queries.rationale: Locate available corpora of real or sanitized network configurations to build realistic tasks and training/evaluation sets (methods & reproducibility).

queries.query: ('formal methods' OR SMT OR 'theorem proving' OR 'model checking') AND ('network' OR 'network configuration' OR 'NetOps')
queries.rationale: Identify formal-methods approaches and SMT-based validators that can provide provable guarantees or stronger oracles for configuration correctness (mechanisms & mitigations).

queries.query: ('safety' OR 'trustworthiness' OR 'assurance' OR 'reliability') AND ('large language model' OR LLM OR 'agentic AI') AND (operations OR NetOps OR 'AIOps')
queries.rationale: Gather conceptual and applied work on safety, assurance, and trust when deploying LLMs/agents in operational domains to inform evaluation criteria and mitigations.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference and journal papers (IEEE, ACM, SIGCOMM, NSDI, USENIX etc.)
High-quality arXiv preprints and technical reports with reproducible artifacts
System/tool papers and official tool documentation (Batfish, Veriflow, Mininet, ns-3) when primary-source
Benchmarks, dataset releases, and their papers or repos (GitHub, project websites)
Reproducible code repositories, demos, and artifacts linked to publications
Standards and operational references (RFCs) relevant to network configuration semantics
English-language works or source material with English abstracts
Works published 2010–2026 (with priority to 2018–2026 and highest priority to 2021–2026)
exclusion_criteria: Unverified claims from anonymous or ephemeral sources lacking primary evidence
Pure marketing materials or vendor marketing collateral without technical detail or reproducibility
Non-technical opinion pieces, press coverage, and social-media posts without supporting artifacts
Closed proprietary datasets or results that cannot be inspected or reproduced publicly
Duplicate summaries that only rehost primary content without added methods or evidence
Non-English works lacking English metadata or translation (unless a verified translation is available)
date_rationale: Include foundational work from 2010 onward to capture classical network verification and configuration literature, but prioritize literature from 2018–2026 for recent AIOps and LLM developments and emphasize 2021–2026 (post-GPT-3/ChatGPT era) for agentic/LLM-specific research and benchmarks.
